source: 上外版选择性必修第一册 Unit 4 同主题听力(选哪项科技/智能家居简介/穹顶之家对话/未来人类预测/求助机器人对话/未来生活贴士)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与读写关不撞。long/short 交替。

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Which Technology Would You Choose
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: If you could have one piece of future technology at home, what would you choose?

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: I'd love a home computer that does all the housework for me.

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: Really? Why that one?

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: Because then I'd have far more leisure time after school.

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: That makes sense. I would choose walls that can move.

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: Moving walls? What for?

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: So I could make my room larger for a party and smaller again later.

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: That sounds like a lot of fun. Maybe one day we'll have both.

exercises.translation_cn: Mia 问 Leo 若能在家拥有一项未来科技会选什么;Leo 想要替他做全部家务的家用电脑,因为放学后能多些闲暇;Mia 想要能移动的墙,这样可以为聚会把房间变大、之后再变小;两人都觉得有趣。

questions.stem: What piece of technology does Leo want?
options: A home computer that does the housework.

questions.stem: Why does Leo want it?
options: To have more leisure time after school.

questions.stem: What does Mia want instead?
Why does Mia want moving walls?
options: To change the size of her room.

questions.stem: How do the two friends feel about the ideas?
options: They think it would be fun.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 What a Smart Home Can Do
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: A smart home connects every device into one network.
With a quick look at your phone, you can control the lighting and temperature.
An electronic servant takes over most of the cleaning chores.
It can even pay the bills and order food for you.
Because of this, people who live there enjoy much more free time.
exercises.translation_cn: 智能家居把每件设备连成一个网络;只需看一眼手机,你就能控制灯光和温度;电子仆人接管大部分清洁家务;它甚至能替你付账单、订食物;因此住在那里的人享有多得多的空闲时间。

questions.stem: What does a smart home connect into one network?
What can you control with a look at your phone?
What does the electronic servant take over?
What else can the home do for you?
options: Pay the bills and order food.

questions.stem: What do people who live there enjoy?

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 A Visit to the Dome House
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Welcome to the dome house. Notice the clear glass roof above us.

transcript.speaker: Visitor
transcript.text: It's beautiful. Does all the power come from the sun?

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Yes. Most of it comes from solar panels in the round roof.

transcript.speaker: Visitor
transcript.text: I don't see any electric sockets on the walls.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: That's right. Each room has a power wall instead. You attach appliances to it.

transcript.speaker: Visitor
transcript.text: Amazing. And why does the air smell so fresh?

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: The system filters the air and then scents it with a perfume you choose.

transcript.speaker: Visitor
transcript.text: I could live here happily for the rest of my life.

exercises.translation_cn: 导游欢迎参观穹顶之家,提到头顶透明的玻璃屋顶;访客觉得美,问电力是否都来自太阳;导游说大部分来自圆顶里的太阳能板;访客发现墙上没有插座;导游解释每个房间有电力墙,把电器附上去即可;访客问空气为何清新;导游说系统过滤空气再加上你选的香味;访客说愿在此长住。

questions.stem: Where does most of the house's power come from?
options: A large battery in the floor.

questions.stem: What does the visitor notice is missing from the walls?
How do people use electrical appliances in this house?
options: They plug them into the floor.
They attach them to a power wall.

questions.stem: Why does the air smell so fresh?
options: The system filters and scents the air.

questions.stem: How does the visitor feel about the house?
options: He would love to live there.
He thinks it is too small.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 How Humans May Change
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Scientists make some interesting predictions about future humans.
Because we use our brains so much, the forehead may grow larger.
Our eyes are likely to become stronger over a very long time.
Arms and legs may grow weaker, since machines do the heavy work.
These are only guesses, but they remind us that humans keep changing.
exercises.translation_cn: 科学家对未来人类做了一些有趣的预测;因为我们大量用脑,前额可能变大;眼睛在很长时间里可能变得更强;手臂和腿可能变弱,因为机器承担了重活;这些只是猜测,但提醒我们人类一直在变化。

questions.stem: Why might the forehead grow larger?
options: Because we use our brains so much.

questions.stem: What may happen to human eyes?
options: They are likely to become stronger.

questions.stem: Why might arms and legs grow weaker?
options: Because machines do the heavy work.

questions.stem: How does the speaker describe these predictions?
What do the predictions remind us of?

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Asking the Home Robot for Help
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Lina, I can't find my school uniform anywhere.

transcript.speaker: Lina
transcript.text: I washed and ironed it last night. It is hanging in the wardrobe.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Oh, thank you. And is my breakfast ready?

transcript.speaker: Lina
transcript.text: Yes. It is waiting on the kitchen table, planned just for you.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Great. What time should I leave for school?

transcript.speaker: Lina
transcript.text: You should leave in ten minutes, so please don't be late.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: All right. I'll be on my way soon.

transcript.speaker: Lina
transcript.text: I'll see you back home by six. Have a good day at school.

exercises.translation_cn: Sam 找不到校服;管家机器人 Lina 说昨晚已洗熨好,挂在衣柜里;Sam 道谢并问早餐;Lina 说已在厨房桌上备好;Sam 问该何时出门;Lina 说十分钟后出发别迟到;Sam 说马上就走;Lina 说六点见,祝在校愉快。

questions.stem: What is Sam looking for at first?
What had Lina done with the uniform?
options: She had given it to a friend.
She had washed and ironed it.

questions.stem: Where is Sam's breakfast?
When should Sam leave for school?
options: At once, with no time left.

questions.stem: What does Lina say at the end?
options: She is too busy to help.
She will see Sam home by six.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 Living Well in the Future
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Technology can make our future homes very comfortable.
But it is wise to stay in control of the machines we use.
Let robots do the boring chores, yet keep making your own choices.
Spend your free time on family, friends and the things you love.
In this way, a smart home will serve you, not replace you.
exercises.translation_cn: 科技能让未来的家非常舒适;但明智的做法是掌控我们使用的机器;让机器人做无聊的家务,但仍由自己做选择;把空闲时间用在家人、朋友和你热爱的事上;这样,智能家居会为你服务,而不是取代你。

questions.stem: What can technology do for our future homes?
What is the wise thing to do with machines?
What should robots be left to do?
How should you spend your free time?
options: On family, friends and things you love.

questions.stem: What is the speaker's main message?
options: A smart home should serve you, not replace you.
